purpose: State the problem: an illustrated review bottleneck beside four numbered pain-point cards.

observedCopy.headline: AI is an Asset and a Risk

cards.label: Bottleneck
cards.title: More to Review
cards.body: The new bottle neck is your team's ability to review all the code agents create.

cards.label: Exposure
cards.title: Hackers Are More Dangerous
cards.body: With AI, bad actors can exploit vulnerabilities faster and more easily than ever before.

cards.label: Volume
cards.title: Your Backlog is Growing
cards.body: Dev teams are forced to slow down to deal with vulnerability backlogs growing from dozens of static scanning tools.

cards.label: Noise
cards.title: False Positives Obscure the Reality
cards.body: Tools of the past can't keep up with the speed of modern teams. False positives sap valuable dev time or cause alert blindness.
